title: herdr-pi role manifest (D76 v2)
description: Tier-2 role manifest contract: version (P2 semantic version) + roleType (P3 planner/executor/hybrid) + tri-state rules (P1 allow/ask/deny). Runtime validation is the hand-written zero-dependency implementation in src/role-manifest.ts; this file is the contract document.

role.description: Role name; must match the file name

model.description: Per-role model routing, provider/model (WS-D10; optional = process default)

guidelines.description: P0 per-role behavior constraints (RFC §4.6): constraints on "how to use" tools that the tool set cannot express, injected each turn as the pier-role prompt section; omit instead of passing an empty array

tools.description: Baseline tools; must include todo_write and ask_user_question (coordination tools, enforced by runtime validation)

rules.description: Tri-state permissions; * is the wildcard default; optional = {"*":"allow"}

unknownTools.description: D82 unknown-tool stance (default deny): allow = user-installed extensions are visible and usable by default (master/worker); deny = anything outside the list is invisible. Orthogonal to the rules * wildcard (visibility vs enforcement)
